what_worked: Setup-and-reveal narrative structure with consistent SO WHAT boxes drives purposeful analytical storytelling throughout.
fix_next: Verify the 5.7x B2B/B2C median claim and confirm the r≈0.02 correlation is for the correct variable pair.
verdict: Strong storytelling undermined by a misattributed correlation and an inflated central multiplier.
factual_error_detail: Slide 6: r≈0.02 (n=984) matches reference founded-year/revenue correlation, not Twitter followers/revenue as claimed. Slide 4: 5.7x B2B/B2C median MRR multiple conflicts with reference 2.35x. Slide 4: stated $1,036/16=$49 per subscriber but actual division yields ~$65.

evidence.insight: Slides 3-4 growth-illusion-to-monetization reveal is genuinely useful framing; slide 5 within-category stress test adds depth; but core 5.7x claim appears inflated vs reference 2.35x
evidence.narrative: Clear thesis from slide 1, sequential build (illusion→reveal→stress test→vanity trap→recs→takeaway), SO WHAT boxes enforce discipline on every analytical slide
evidence.framing: Slide 2 shows 288 unclassified audience types but never discusses how this 29% missingness affects B2B/B2C conclusions; no limitations slide; sub-cell sample sizes for slide 5 categories unreported
evidence.accuracy: Revenue total and audience split verified correct; however r≈0.02 is misattributed (reference: founded-year/revenue not Twitter/revenue); 5.7x multiple conflicts with reference 2.35x; $49 per-subscriber arithmetic inconsistent with own stated inputs
evidence.visual: Consistent navy/orange palette, clean hierarchy, effective grouped bar chart on slide 5, readable scatter on slide 6, no chart junk; decorative curve on slide 1 is meaningless but minor
evidence.ai_slop: Minimal — design is polished and purposeful, SO WHAT boxes add substance, no generic filler language detected

change_reason: Downgraded accuracy from 5.5 to 4.5 due to confirmed misattributed correlation (founded-year r passed off as Twitter-followers r) and inflated 5.7x multiple vs reference 2.35x. Reduced bonus from 2 to 1 and adjusted insight/narrative/framing slightly downward given factual foundation issues.
